symbols.name: finite ground set
symbols.meaning: The finite set from which the subsets $E_i$ are taken, so that a uniformly random element of it can be used to compute probabilities.
symbols.quote: Here $\Omega$ is a finite [Ground set](ground-set.md), and the union bound in counting form is applied to subsets of it.

symbols.name: ground subset
symbols.meaning: One of the subsets of $\Omega$ whose union the bound controls.
symbols.quote: Each $E_i$ is one of the subsets of $\Omega$, and $m$ is the number of these subsets, $E_1, \dots, E_m$.

symbols.name: number of subsets
symbols.meaning: The number of subsets $E_1, \dots, E_m$ of $\Omega$ whose union is bounded.
symbols.quote: Each $E_i$ is one of the subsets of $\Omega$, and $m$ is the number of these subsets, $E_1, \dots, E_m$.

symbols.name: selected position count
symbols.meaning: The number of selected bit positions $j_0, \dots, j_{f-1}$ in the packed operation.
symbols.quote: Here $f$ is the number of selected bit positions $j_0, \dots, j_{f-1}$ and $K$ is the width in bits of each segment.

symbols.name: segment width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each segment, so that each guard value takes one of $2^{K-1}$ values.
symbols.quote: Here $f$ is the number of selected bit positions $j_0, \dots, j_{f-1}$ and $K$ is the width in bits of each segment.
